description: 인천항만공사_인천항 차량 통계 정보 조회 서비스 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 인천항만공사. 해당 자료는 인천항 내 차량 출입정보에 관한 API 명세서로, 출입차량의 종류와 출입 경로 및 통계를 수집하고 분석할 수 있는 기반 자료입니다. API는 REST 방식으로 호출되며, 조회 기간 설정을 위한 searchStartDt, searchEndDT와 같은 요청 파라미터를 통해 특정 기간의 차량 출입... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 인천항만공사. Its tags are 차량 출입, 인천항, 출입정보, 입출문코드, 입출문구분. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-04-09 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
